dedupe_keys.name: ev charging responses under power quality disturbances

description: The electric-vehicle power-quality team publishes charging tests under ten controlled electrical disturbances. The public OSF node lists the data archive, README and technical-validation code. The article says each test has a CSV of synchronized voltage and current against time, with filenames encoding disturbance type, voltage, frequency, duration and start time. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-28; obtaining it is free of charge. Coverage is a laboratory charger and battery test protocol, not all public charging stations. The signals can validate charger response under distribution-grid disturbance simulations alongside a network context such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that tests isolate one disturbance at a time and mostly start at fixed state of charge; real feeders can combine faults and diverse vehicles. Own OSF metadata and article Data Records were read without downloading CSVs or running validation code.
